note: per-trade rows at 1.5x/2.0x; SAME fills/trades, costs re-charged by accounting.run_accounting at each tier (equity path differs, so per-trade fees/funding are NOT a constant multiple of the 1.0x rows)

csv_columns_documented.mfe_ret/mae_ret: max/min over the holding window of high/low vs entry fill price (entry=fill bar open; window = entry..exit-1 for open-class exits, entry..exit inclusive for close-class FOLD_END/SERIES_END exits)
csv_columns_documented.mfe_usd/mae_usd: mfe_ret/mae_ret x equity at entry (fraction 1.0); descriptive
csv_columns_documented.hold_bars: accounting convention: exit fill bar - entry fill bar
csv_columns_documented.bars_held_decision_space: lane machine bars_held (decision bars in position)
csv_columns_documented.realized_vol_20: std(ddof=1) of the 20 log closes-to-close returns ending at the decision bar
csv_columns_documented.dd_from_high_200: close[decision]/max(close over up to prior 200 bars incl. decision) - 1
csv_columns_documented.donchian_rank: share of the prior-30-close Donchian entry window strictly below the decision close (1.0 = fresh 30-bar high)
csv_columns_documented.phase_label_at_entry: frozen PIT phase label at the decision bar
csv_columns_documented.PIT_law: covariates use bars with close time <= decision time only (indices 0..decision_bar of the engine's truncated series)
